product_family: AI calendar/scheduling assistant for work and life; single product surface (web app + browser extension + Google/Outlook calendar sync) with tiered plans (Lite/free, Starter, Business, Enterprise) rather than distinct sub-products. Enterprise tier adds SSO/SCIM and org-wide analytics.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: We have completed our first SOC2 Type II audit with A-Lign. ... Reclaim is SOC2 Type II certified as of September 2023, and was renewed in 2024.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA or ISO 27001 certifications are mentioned on this trust center page. Reclaim's own security page references ISO 27001 only in the context of AWS's data-center compliance standards (the cloud host's certification, not Reclaim's own).

certifications.name: GDPR (posture/compliance program)
certifications.proof_quote: Reclaim is committed to complying with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)... Data Processing Addendum incorporated into business terms; EU-US Data Privacy Framework re-certification completed.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: We have completed our re-certification under the Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on Reclaim's own trust center, security page, or help center of a HIPAA compliance program or BAA offering. A third-party aggregator search result claimed 'HIPAA compliant', but this is not corroborated on any reclaim.ai-owned page.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Not listed on the trust center or security page; billing is handled via Stripe (a PCI DSS Level 1 subprocessor), so Reclaim itself does not directly handle card data. No public evidence of a Reclaim-held PCI DSS certification.

certifications.name: CCPA compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Reclaim is committed to complying with the ... California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any reclaim.ai-owned page. Not a government-focused product; not listed on trust center.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any reclaim.ai-owned page. Not listed on trust center.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI governance certification. Reclaim addresses AI-data-use posture only via a contractual privacy-policy commitment, not a certified AI management system.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy states: 'We will not use and will not authorize any of our third-party service providers to use your Personal Data (including your Calendar Data or App Data) to train any large language or other generative AI models unless we have separately and explicitly obtained your prior consent or you have expressly opted into our use of your Personal Data for such purposes through the Services.' The subprocessors page lists OpenAI as an AI subprocessor 'by opt-in only' for AI-enabled features (LLMs and embeddings), consistent with the opt-in framing. No tier-based difference in this policy was found (applies across plans); no legacy-ToS contradiction found (ToS itself is silent on AI training and defers to the privacy policy).

flags: A third-party aggregator search result claimed Reclaim is 'HIPAA compliant, PCI compliant, ISO 27001 compliant, FedRAMP compliant, and CSA Star Level 1 compliant', but none of this is corroborated on any reclaim.ai-owned page; the trust center explicitly does not list HIPAA or ISO 27001.
